title: What Is a Rug Pull? 3 Warning Signs Every Crypto Beginner Should Know
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A rug pull is when a project's creators drain funds and disappear. Sources: CoinDesk, Investopedia. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: THE RUG PULL
scenes.narration: Ever heard of a rug pull? It is one of the most talked about traps in crypto, and beginners often meet it first.

scenes.head: WHAT IS IT?
scenes.narration: In a rug pull, creators hype a new token, wait for buyers, then take the money and disappear, as CoinDesk and Investopedia describe.

scenes.head: WARNING SIGN ONE
scenes.narration: Sign one. Nobody knows who runs the project, and the hype pushes you to hurry.

scenes.head: WARNING SIGN TWO
scenes.narration: Sign two. A few wallets hold most of the supply, the liquidity is not locked, and no independent audit exists.

scenes.head: WARNING SIGN THREE
scenes.narration: Sign three. Promises of huge returns, hype from influencers, or a token that is hard to sell.

scenes.head: STAY CAREFUL
items: Never risk what you can't lose
scenes.narration: Research the team, read independent reviews, and never put in money you cannot afford to lose.
